bulletin.title: Bulletin: forest mushroom
bulletin.intro: Today's notice: Momo wants a forest mushroom for the lunch stew. There's a good patch by the bridge path in the Whispering forest.
bulletin.outro: Delivered and stamped. Juniper will have the coins waiting.

bulletin.title: Bulletin: river lily
bulletin.intro: Today's notice: Hana is pressing flowers and wants a river lily. They float near the north bridge.
bulletin.outro: Pressed flat and pretty. Job done.

bulletin.title: Bulletin: biggest pine cone
bulletin.intro: Today's notice: Pip is running a pine cone contest and wants the biggest one from the forest edge.
bulletin.outro: Pip says it's the biggest cone in village history.

bulletin.title: Bulletin: marsh driftwood
bulletin.intro: Today's notice: Kiko needs a piece of driftwood for a new fishing perch. The marsh washes some up south of the reeds.
bulletin.outro: Kiko is already whittling it. Nice work.

bulletin.title: Bulletin: pumpkin seeds
bulletin.intro: Today's notice: Tofu wants roasted pumpkin seeds for the bathhouse guests. Hana leaves a seed pouch out in the meadow.
bulletin.outro: Salty, warm, and gone in a minute. Tofu sends thanks.
